EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 974 July 24, 1984
Subject Matter : Further amending Executive Order No. 920, series of 1983 entitled "Levying an Export Duty
on certain export products in addition to the export duties provided for under PD No. 1464, as amended, on
other export products".
Date of Effectivity : July 24, 1984
